actionable_proposals.description: Add shot-chart spatial embeddings as feature category in features/engine.py. The MDPI 2026 paper shows these contribute to achieving 0.199 Brier with LR.
Add isotonic calibration + MC Dropout uncertainty pass to island post-processing. Islands output raw probabilities; adding a calibration layer could close the gap from 0.22034 toward 0.21.
Implement L1(XGB+LGB+RF)->L2(LR) stacking in GA mutation pool. Sci Reports 2025 achieved 77.5% accuracy. Currently islands only use single-model architectures.
Ensure rolling-form indicators (last-5, last-10, momentum) are prominently weighted in feature selection. MDPI paper identifies these as key contributors alongside ELO.

next_action: Present P3 (two-layer stacking) to VM for engine.py mutation pool addition — lowest effort, highest POL transferability.
